messages.author: 75f13e4220a9d6c3
messages.subject: pooling biological replicates
parts:
Dear all,
I am trying to pool replicates to have  only test and control sample groups. I use pool function of methylKit to do that and i note this error message.
Here is my code:

>sampleName1='X1_30S_report_out2.txt'
> sampleName2='X2_9S_report_out2.txt'
> sampleName2='X3_12S_report_out2.txt'
> sampleName4='X1_11NS_report_out2.txt'
> sampleName5='Y2_35NS_report_out2.txt'
> sampleName6='Y13_38NS_report_out2.txt'
> myobj <- read(sample.list,sample.id = list(sampleName1,sampleName2,sampleName3,sampleName4),assembly="AGPv2",treatment=c(1,1,0,0),context='CpG')
>pooled.S<-pool(myobj,sample.ids=c("sampleName1","sampleName2", "sampleName3"))

Error in (function (classes, fdef, mtable)  :
  unable to find an inherited method for function 'pool' for signature '"methylRawList"'

First, I thought that this is because 'myobj' is a methylRawlist and pool() needs a methylBase.

I tried to use unite function in order to produce bases covered in all samples and obtain a methylBase. After that I retried the pool. I had the same error message.


>meth <- unite (myobj, destrand=FALSE)
>pooled.S<-pool(myobj,sample.ids=c("sampleName1","sampleName2", "sampleName3"))

Error in (function (classes, fdef, mtable)  :
  unable to find an inherited method for function 'pool' for signature '"methylRawList"'

Looking forward to your response

Thank you
Best,
Zeineb

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] pooling biological replicates
parts:
there is an error in your code. pool() functions needs a methylBase object. please check documentation

Best,
Altuna
